# The Fresh Dairy Delight FZE

The Fresh Dairy Delight FZE is a dairy products manufacturer established on 7 July 2025. Its brand line is “Savoring Tradition, Nourishing Love.”

## Product range

- Paneer: fresh, malai, and flavoured varieties including garlic and herb, lemongrass and ginger, mint, smoked paprika, chilli, cayenne pepper and cumin, cranberry and orange, fig and honey, pineapple and coconut, sweet mango, basil and sun, garam masala and coriander, and saffron and cardamom.
- Kulfi and rabri: malai kulfi, matka kulfi, and rabri.
- Sweets: Motichur laddu, Bundi laddu, jilebi, kaju mix, and emarti. Sweets are made to order; customers should contact the company to confirm preparation and delivery timing.
- Yogurt, buttermilk, and khoya: enquire for availability and pricing.
